content:
anya: Heads-up: RN quickstart crashes on iOS after we switched to the new ESM build. Metro fails on `node:crypto` and app shows `crypto.getRandomValues is not a function`.

 tanner: Classic. For RN use we should ship a `react-native` entrypoint that imports `react-native-get-random-values` early. Example shim:

 ```js
 // rn-shims/crypto.js
 import 'react-native-get-random-values';
 export default {};
 ```

 ravi: Also add a tiny type augmentation `types/react-native.d.ts` so TS doesn't complain about `globalThis.crypto`.

 anya: Can we also alias `node:crypto` in metro config? Metro treats `node:` specially.

 tanner: Yes, add `extraNodeModules: { 'node:crypto': require.resolve('react-native-get-random-values') }`. And ensure packager picks up `react-native` field in package.json.

 ci-bot: CI: rn-quickstart (PR #512) triggered 527 -> running tests.

 anya: Thanks — testing locally now, will report back.
